source: benchmarks/framefem.json accepted 2026-09-05 (run_at 2026-09-05T13:15:00Z): inputs and closed-form reference values as recorded by the harness of that run; that harness is not in this tree.
reference: Closed-form Euler–Bernoulli static, free-vibration and Euler-column buckling solutions plus axial-bar, SDOF and exact reduced-matrix P-Delta identities, recorded on 2026-09-05 by an independent harness. Each case is computed by framefem.html in Chromium through its own analyze(); nine further cases execute the page-generated standard-library Python exports for static, static end-release, P-Delta, P-Delta end-release, modal, modal end-release, buckling and buckling end-release states.
reference_citations: Reference identities: simply supported UDL R=wL/2, Mmax=wL^2/8, delta=5wL^4/(384EI); central point load R=P/2, Mmax=PL/4, delta=PL^3/(48EI); cantilever tip force delta=PL^3/(3EI), theta=PL^2/(2EI); tip moment delta=ML^2/(2EI), theta=ML/EI; axial u=PL/EA; restrained thermal force N=EA alpha DeltaT. These are standard Euler–Bernoulli/axial-bar results derivable directly from equilibrium and EI v''=M / EA u'=N.
Modal references: simply-supported f_n=n^2*pi/(2L^2)*sqrt(EI/mu); cantilever f_n=beta_n^2/(2*pi*L^2)*sqrt(EI/mu), beta={1.8751040687,4.6940911330,7.8547574382}; SDOF f=(1/2*pi)*sqrt(k/m).
Buckling references: Euler Pcr=pi^2 EI/(K L)^2, with K=1 for pinned-pinned and K=2 for fixed-free; restrained thermal compression N=EA alpha DeltaT; eigenvalue factor lambda=Pcr/Pref.

Second-order references: Kg=0 reduces exactly to scaled linear statics; a one-element fixed-guided column with one transverse DOF gives u=H/(12EI/L^3 - 36P/(30L)); for a fixed-pinned released end, direct condensation of the 2x2 tangent [v,theta_h] gives u=H/(A-B^2/D); continuation beyond tangent singularity must be rejected.

Cross-check coverage additionally includes member end-moment release condensation (double-hinged and fixed-pinned UDL beams), fully restrained static reaction recovery, coordinate transformation (3-4-5 inclined member), nodal ground spring stiffness, linear load-combination superposition, two-element assembly consistency, stable zero-load solve, singular-mechanism rejection, consistent-mass modal convergence, exact internal-DOF member-release modal assembly, exact SDOF participation/effective mass and zero-mass rejection.

Python-export regression executes the generated scripts under bare python3. Static export includes member end-release condensation and released free-DOF filtering; modal export preserves released-end consistent mass with independent internal rotational DOFs; static/P-Delta use dense Gaussian elimination; modal/buckling use dense Cholesky congruence plus symmetric Jacobi, providing a solver path structurally different from the browser sparse PCG/subspace implementation.

cases.note: Simply supported beam, full UDL: R=wL/2, Mmax=wL^2/8, delta_max=5wL^4/(384EI).
Simply supported beam, central point load: R=P/2, Mmax=PL/4, delta_max=PL^3/(48EI).
Simply supported beam, offset point load: reactions and M at load point.
Cantilever, tip transverse force: delta=PL^3/(3EI), theta=PL^2/(2EI), Mroot=PL.
Cantilever, tip moment: theta=ML/EI, delta=ML^2/(2EI), constant M.
Horizontal cantilever member under pure axial tip force: u=PL/EA and N=P.
Axial member and nodal ground spring act in parallel: u=P/(EA/L+k).
Cantilever member with uniform temperature change and free axial end: u=alpha*dT*L, N=0.
Uniform temperature change with both axial ends restrained: |N|=EA alpha dT.
3-4-5 inclined cantilever member loaded along its local axis; tests global/local transformation.
1.35G+1.5Q on a simply supported beam; checks exact linear superposition of solved base cases.
Simply supported UDL beam split into two frame elements; must reproduce one-element closed form.
Simply supported beam with applied end moment: vertical reactions +/-M/L and |M|max=|M|.
A stable frame with zero load must solve to exactly zero; the stability probe must not mistake zero RHS for evidence of stability.
Unrestrained member has rigid-body modes and must be rejected as singular, even with zero applied load.
Both member end moments released while nodal Rz DOFs are restrained: recovers the simply-supported UDL closed form and zero hinge moments.
One end moment released with every global nodal DOF restrained; static condensation still permits the internal hinge rotation and returns fixed-pinned reactions.
Undamped uniform cantilever, 8 consistent-mass frame elements; first three bending frequencies vs Euler-Bernoulli characteristic roots cosh(beta) cos(beta) = -1.
Undamped uniform simply-supported beam, 8 consistent-mass elements; first two bending modes f_n = n^2*pi/(2L^2)*sqrt(EI/mu).

End support Rz DOFs are fixed while the first/last member ends are explicitly released. Independent internal hinge rotations with consistent mass must recover the same simply-supported Euler-Bernoulli spectrum.
Axial bar stiffness k=EA/L with a single nodal mass and zero member mass reduces exactly to one DOF: f=(1/2pi)sqrt(k/m).
One active translational DOF with nodal mass m must have active mass m and 100% effective modal mass in X.
A stable stiffness model with zero member and nodal mass must be rejected rather than returning artificial frequencies.
Pinned-pinned uniform Euler column, 8 elements, reference compression P: lambda_cr = pi^2 EI/(L^2 P).
Fixed-free uniform Euler column, 8 elements, reference compression P: lambda_cr = pi^2 EI/(4 L^2 P).
Pinned column with both axial ends restrained; uniform DeltaT creates N=EA alpha DeltaT and lambda_cr=P_Euler/N.
Pinned column in pure axial tension has signed stabilizing geometric stiffness and must not return a positive buckling factor.
With zero axial pre-stress Kg=0, P-Delta continuation must reduce exactly to lambda K u=lambda F.
Fixed-guided one-element beam-column has one lateral DOF: u=H/(12EI/L^3 - 36P/(30L)) for the implemented initial-stress matrix.
Continuation beyond the one-DOF tangent singularity must stop instead of returning a post-critical displacement from PCG.
Fixed-pinned beam-column with the nodal Rz restrained but member end B released. Condensing the internal hinge rotation from the 2x2 tangent gives u=H/(A-B^2/D).
Pinned-pinned Euler column with support Rz fixed and kinematic pins supplied only by member end releases; lambda_cr=pi^2 EI/(L^2 P).
